text:
Predicates:
Taller(x, y) ::: x is taller than y.
Blocks(x, y) ::: x can block y's shooting.
Jump(x) ::: x can jump when shooting.
GreatShooter(x) ::: x is a great shooter.
Shoots(x, y) ::: x shoots at y.
Michael(x) ::: x is Michael.
Windy(y) ::: y is Windy.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
Class(x) ::: x is in Michael's class.

Premises:
∀x ∀y (Taller(x, y) → Blocks(x, y)) ::: If x is taller than y, then x can block y's shooting.
Michael(x) ∧ ∀y (Person(y) → Taller(x, y)) ::: Michael is taller than everyone else in his class.
∀x ∀y ∀z ((Taller(x, y) ∧ Taller(y, z)) → Taller(x, z)) ::: If x is taller than y and y is taller than z, then x is taller than z.
Peter(x) ∧ Taller(x, Michael) ::: Peter is taller than Michael.
Michael(x) ::: x is Michael.
¬Blocks(Michael, Windy) ::: Michael cannot block Windy's shooting.
∀x (Jump(x) → GreatShooter(x)) ::: Every shooter who can jump is a great shooter.
